title: Mandatory Nutrition Declaration Basis (per 100 g or per 100 ml)
explanation: The mandatory nutrition declaration must be expressed per 100 g or per 100 ml. Per-portion declarations are permitted only in addition to per 100 g/ml.

title: Mandatory Dual Energy Declaration (kJ and kcal)
explanation: Energy value must be given in both kilojoules (kJ) and kilocalories (kcal). Conversion ratio: 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ.

title: Mandatory 7 Nutrients in Prescribed Standard Order
explanation: The mandatory declaration must present: energy, fat, of which saturates, carbohydrate, of which sugars, protein, and salt in standard order.

title: Salt Content Declaration (Salt = Sodium × 2.5)
explanation: The mandatory declaration requires 'Salt', calculated as salt = sodium × 2.5. Stating sodium alone does not fulfill EU mandatory declaration requirements.

title: Allergen Emphasis in the List of Ingredients
explanation: Substances causing allergies or intolerances (Annex II) must be emphasized in the ingredient list through a typeset that clearly distinguishes them from the rest of the list.

title: Mandatory Particulars Legibility (x-height >= 1.2 mm or >= 0.9 mm)
explanation: Mandatory particulars must be printed with an x-height equal to or greater than 1.2 mm (or 0.9 mm where the largest surface has an area of less than 80 cm²).

title: Mandatory Particulars (Name, Net Quantity, Operator, Storage)
explanation: Prepacked food labels must declare: legal name of food, net quantity (in metric liters/cL/mL or kg/g), food business operator name/address, date of minimum durability, and storage conditions.
